title: Grounded-VideoLLM: Sharpening Fine-grained Temporal Grounding in Video Large Language Models

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Grounded-VideoLLM: Sharpening Fine-grained Temporal Grounding in Video Large Language Models Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in coarse-grained video understanding, however, they struggle with fine-grained temporal grounding.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: In light of this, we sharpen our model by incorporating (1) an additional temporal stream to encode the relationships between frames and (2) discrete temporal tokens enriched with specific time knowledge to represent timestamps.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: We meticulously select different tasks for each stage, and progressively refine the model in a “coarse-to-fine” manner, transitioning from image understanding to video comprehension, and ultimately to fine-grained temporal grounding.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: In this paper, we introduce Grounded-VideoLLM, a novel Video-LLM adept at perceiving and reasoning over specific video moments in a fine-grained manner.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: This scheme ensures the introduced temporal tokens align closely with the video timelines and LLM’s semantic space, distinguishing our method from previous studies (Huang et al., 2024b; Qian et al., 2024a; Yang et al., 2023).

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: To further enhance Grounded-VideoLLM's temporal reasoning capability, we also curate a grounded VideoQA dataset by an automatic annotation pipeline.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: We meticulously select different tasks for each stage, and progressively refine the model in a “coarse-to-fine” manner, transitioning from image understanding to video comprehension, and ultimately to fine-grained temporal grounding.
